dialogue.origin: こんばんは本日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: お時間になりましたら、声掛けさせていただきますね
dialogue.content: I'll let you know when our time is up.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員ですよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm your counselor. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.origin: まずはじめにご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか
dialogue.content: First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ
dialogue.content: Likewise.

dialogue.origin: 17才　男
dialogue.content: 17, male.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただいて有難うございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: いえ
dialogue.content: No problem.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: So, what would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: なんかめんどくさくなって
dialogue.content: Things have just become a hassle...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなことがあったのか、もう少し詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a bit more about what’s been going on?

dialogue.origin: 毎月保護司と会うんですけど
dialogue.content: I have to meet with my probation officer every month.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 会わなくてもなんとかならないかなと
dialogue.content: I was wondering if there's any way to get out of meeting them.

dialogue.origin: 会うとどんなことがあるのでしょうか
dialogue.content: What happens when you meet with them?

dialogue.origin: 話をします
dialogue.content: We talk.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 例えばどんな話をされますか
dialogue.content: For example, what kind of things do you talk about?

dialogue.origin: 聞かれたこと話します。近況報告ですね
dialogue.content: I just answer their questions. It's basically a status update.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 保護司さんと会う時に、どんなことがめんどうだと感じておられますか
dialogue.content: What is it about meeting with your probation officer that you find to be a hassle?

dialogue.origin: わざわざ時間空けなきゃいけないこと
dialogue.content: The fact that I have to make time for it.

dialogue.origin: その時間が無駄だなと感じてしまうのでしょうか、、
dialogue.content: Do you feel like that time is wasted...?

dialogue.origin: 無駄というか、会わなきゃいけないから会ってるけど
dialogue.content: It's not that it's a waste, but I meet them because I have to.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: めんどくさいなと思ってる
dialogue.content: I just think it’s a hassle.

dialogue.origin: 会わなきゃいけないと思うと、強制的な感じがして嫌になってきますよね、、
dialogue.content: When you feel you *have* to meet, it can feel forced, which is unpleasant, isn't it...?

dialogue.origin: 強制的か
dialogue.content: Forced, huh.

dialogue.origin: そうかも
dialogue.content: Maybe so.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: どんなことがあって保護司と会うようになったのでしょうか（お話しできる範囲で結構です）
dialogue.content: What led to you meeting with a probation officer? Only share what you’re comfortable with.

dialogue.origin: 万引き
dialogue.content: Shoplifting.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: それはいつ頃の出来事ですか
dialogue.content: When did that happen?

dialogue.origin: 去年の秋
dialogue.content: Last fall.

dialogue.origin: 相談にのりたいと思うので、そのことについてもう少しお話することできますか？
dialogue.content: I'd like to help you with this, so would you be willing to talk about it a little more?

dialogue.origin: 何の相談ですか？
dialogue.content: Help with what?

dialogue.origin: 保護司と会うことがめんどうと感じていることをどうすればいいか、一緒に考えたいと思うんですが
dialogue.content: I'd like to think together about what we can do about the feeling that meeting your probation officer is a hassle.

dialogue.origin: あー😩保護司のおばさんに会うのがめんどっちなの
dialogue.content: Ugh😩 It's just a pain to meet with that probation officer lady.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: その時にどんなことが頭に浮かぶかな？
dialogue.content: What goes through your mind at that time?

dialogue.origin: 会わなきゃいけないから仕方ないけど
dialogue.content: I have to meet her, so it is what it is, but…

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 他にもやりたいことあるしさ
dialogue.content: I've got other things I want to do.

dialogue.origin: やりたいことあるのに、時間使われるのはつらいよね、、
dialogue.content: It's tough to have your time taken up when there are other things you'd rather be doing...

dialogue.origin: 優しいおばさんなんだけどさ
dialogue.content: She's a nice lady, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: めんどくさいだよね。
dialogue.content: But it's still a hassle.

dialogue.origin: 他にやりたいことって、どんなことかよかったら教えてもらえるかな？
dialogue.content: If you don't mind sharing, what are some of those other things you'd like to be doing?

dialogue.origin: 家でごろごろ
dialogue.content: Just lazing around at home.

dialogue.origin: そんなめんどくさい時間なら、家でごろごろしてたいって感じかな
dialogue.content: So it feels like if you have to spend time on something that's such a hassle, you'd rather be at home lazing around?

dialogue.origin: 家でゴロゴロしてたいんだよ
dialogue.content: I just want to laze around at home.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、無駄な時間だと思うとそう思うよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, if you see it as a waste of time, that makes sense...

dialogue.origin: 無駄ではない
dialogue.content: It's not a waste.

dialogue.origin: そっか、ごめんね
dialogue.content: I see, I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: いえ
dialogue.content: It's fine.

dialogue.origin: その時間は「めんどくさい」なんだよね
dialogue.content: So that time is just a "hassle," right?

dialogue.origin: 前は家に来てくれたのに今月からは自分が出向かなきゃいけないんだ
dialogue.content: She used to come to my house, but starting this month, I have to go to her.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね
dialogue.content: Oh, I see.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: それって、なんでそうなったのかな？
dialogue.content: Do you know why it changed?

dialogue.origin: 知らん
dialogue.content: Dunno.

dialogue.origin: 何か事前に連絡とか無かった感じかな
dialogue.content: Was there no notice beforehand or anything?

dialogue.origin: 前回会った時に次からは来てねと言ってた
dialogue.content: When we met last time, she just said, "From next time on, you come to me."

dialogue.origin: 理由は聞かされずかな？
dialogue.content: So you weren’t told the reason?

dialogue.origin: 保護の言うことは絶対でしょ
dialogue.content: What a probation officer says is absolute, right?

dialogue.origin: 保護司の言うことは絶対でしょ
dialogue.content: What a probation officer says is absolute, right?

dialogue.origin: そっか、それもそうだよね
dialogue.content: I see, that's true.

dialogue.origin: あーあ　やだな
dialogue.content: Ugh, I really don’t want to.

dialogue.origin: うんうん絶対守らないとって、思ってるとしんどくなるよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, it must be tiring to always feel like you absolutely have to obey...

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 近況報告するのが嫌なのか、保護司のおばさんと会うのが嫌なのか、時間がとられるのが嫌とか　自分ではどんな感じかな？
dialogue.content: Is it that you dislike giving the progress reports, meeting the probation officer herself, or that it takes up your time? How does it feel to you?

dialogue.origin: いくのが嫌
dialogue.content: I don’t like going.

dialogue.origin: そっか、たしかに出向かないといけないのはしんどいよね・・
dialogue.content: I see. Having to go out of your way to meet them is definitely tough...

dialogue.origin: めんどくさい
dialogue.content: It’s a hassle.

dialogue.origin: バイクダメ出し
dialogue.content: She said I can't use my motorcycle.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ・・・
dialogue.content: Oh, really...

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 何でか聞いた？
dialogue.content: Did you ask why?

dialogue.origin: 学校で禁止だから
dialogue.content: Because it's not allowed at school.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっかどこで会ってるのかな？
dialogue.content: I see. So where are you meeting?

dialogue.origin: 駅前のなんとかセンターって言ってた
dialogue.content: She said some kind of center in front of the station.

dialogue.origin: もしかすると今度初めて外で会う感じかな？
dialogue.content: So this might be the first time you're meeting outside your home?

dialogue.origin: そう
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: そっか、はじめてだと少し緊張するよね
dialogue.content: I see. The first time can be a little nerve-wracking, can't it?

dialogue.origin: いや
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: そっか、じゃあどんな感じかな？
dialogue.content: I see. Then how does it feel?

dialogue.origin: めんどくさいだけ
dialogue.content: Just a hassle.

dialogue.origin: うちに来てくれればいいのに
dialogue.content: I wish she would just come to my house.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: うちのほうが楽だよね、、
dialogue.content: It's easier at home, isn't it...

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 歩きか自転車でこいだって
dialogue.content: She told me to come on foot or by bicycle.

dialogue.origin: そっか、めんどうだよね、、
dialogue.content: I see, that is a hassle...

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: そんな思いとかは保護司さんに言ったことはあるかな？
dialogue.content: Have you ever told your probation officer how you feel about that?

dialogue.origin: なんて言うの？
dialogue.content: What would I say?

dialogue.origin: もう少し家に来てくれる期間を延ばしてもらえませんか？とかかな・・・
dialogue.content: Maybe something like, "Could you please continue coming to my house for a little longer?"...

dialogue.origin: 高校卒業するまで会う約束になってるんだ
dialogue.content: I'm supposed to meet with her until I graduate high school.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか
dialogue.content: I see, I see.

dialogue.origin: ちゃんと保護司さんとの約束を守っている感じなんだね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're doing a good job of keeping your promise with your probation officer.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 守らないとダメでしょ
dialogue.content: I have to keep it, right?

dialogue.origin: そんなふうに思ってるんだね、「守らないとダメ」って
dialogue.content: So that's how you see it, that you "have to keep it."

dialogue.origin: なんで。
dialogue.content: Why?

dialogue.origin: それってすごいことだなと思って、、
dialogue.content: I just think that's really impressive...

dialogue.origin: 約束守らないと鑑別所戻っちゃうよ
dialogue.content: If I don't keep my promise, I'll end up back in juvenile detention.

dialogue.origin: うんうん絶対戻りたくないよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, you definitely don't want to go back there...

dialogue.origin: だからこそ今頑張ってるんだよね
dialogue.content: That's why you're trying so hard now, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってはいない
dialogue.content: I'm not trying hard.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そんなふうにも感じてるんだね、、
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how you feel about it...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 何でそう思うのかな？
dialogue.content: What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: なんで？わかんない
dialogue.content: Why? I don't know.

dialogue.origin: なんとなく、そんなふうに思うって感じかな
dialogue.content: Is it just a vague feeling you have?

dialogue.origin: 何を？
dialogue.content: About what?

dialogue.origin: 自分が頑張ってないって思うこと
dialogue.content: About thinking that you're not trying hard.

dialogue.origin: だって家でゴロゴロしてるから
dialogue.content: Because I’m just lazing around at home.

dialogue.origin: ご両親とかには保護司さんとのこと何か言ってるかな？
dialogue.content: Have you said anything to your parents about the probation officer?

dialogue.origin: 親？
dialogue.content: My parents?

dialogue.origin: ご家族は一緒にいるのかな？
dialogue.content: Are you living with your family?

dialogue.origin: 親なんていないし
dialogue.content: I don't have any parents.

dialogue.origin: そっか、気にしていること聞いたかな、、ごめんなさいね・・
dialogue.content: I see… I may have touched on something sensitive. I’m sorry.

dialogue.origin: 気になんかしてないし、保護司さんは優しいから好きだよ
dialogue.content: I'm not bothered by it, and I like my probation officer because she's kind.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、保護司さんのことは好きなんだね
dialogue.content: I see, so you do like your probation officer.

dialogue.origin: まね
dialogue.content: Well, yeah.

dialogue.origin: そうすると、今は一人で家で暮らしている感じかな？
dialogue.content: So, are you living at home by yourself right now?

dialogue.origin: 婆ちゃんがいる
dialogue.content: My grandma's here.

dialogue.origin: そっか、お婆ちゃんとそれは少し安心するところもあるかと思うけどどうかな？
dialogue.content: I see. Having your grandmother there might feel a bit reassuring. How does that feel to you?

dialogue.origin: なんで安心するの？
dialogue.content: Why would that be reassuring?

dialogue.origin: 近くに自分を知ってくれている人がいると、少し安心するかなって思って
dialogue.content: I thought it might feel a bit reassuring to have someone nearby who knows you.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、自分ではそうでもない感じかな
dialogue.content: I see, so you don't really feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: 少し相談員の感じたことを伝えてもいいなかな？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I share an observation?

dialogue.origin: どうぞ
dialogue.content: Go ahead.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: これまで保護司さんとの面談を守らないといけないって思いながら続けていて、
dialogue.content: You've been continuing these meetings with your probation officer, all the while feeling that you absolutely have to,

dialogue.origin: これって本当にすごいなって、頑張ってるなって私はおもいました
dialogue.content: and I find that really impressive. I think you've been trying very hard.

dialogue.origin: 守らなくていいの？
dialogue.content: Are you saying I don’t have to keep them?

dialogue.origin: そう、自分でも思っている通り、守らないといけないと思うよ
dialogue.content: No, just as you believe yourself, I think you do have to keep the promise.

dialogue.origin: こうして続けてこれていることは、自分ではどう思うかな？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about the fact that you’ve been able to keep it up like this?

dialogue.origin: わかんない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか
dialogue.content: I see, okay.

dialogue.origin: ちゃんと保護司に会いにいくから大丈夫だよ
dialogue.content: Don't worry, I'll go meet my probation officer like I'm supposed to.

dialogue.origin: うんうんそうやって必ず守ってるよね、そこがホントにすごいと思う
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, you always keep your promise. I think that's what's truly amazing.

dialogue.origin: 実はそうやって続けて頑張ってこれたからこそ、今月から自分から出向いて会いに行くという次のステップに進んだんだと思うんだけど、そう考えるとどう思うかな？
dialogue.content: Actually, I think it's precisely because you've continued to try so hard that you've been able to move on to this next step of going to meet her yourself starting this month. What do you think when you consider it that way?

dialogue.origin: いや、家でゴロゴロしてっから、外でなさいってさ
dialogue.content: Nah, she just said that since I'm always lazing around at home, I should get out of the house.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、そんな感じなんだね
dialogue.content: I see, so that’s how it feels to you.

dialogue.origin: あざっす
dialogue.content: Thanks.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、少しずつでも前に進んでいるように感じたよ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. I feel that you're moving forward, little by little.

dialogue.origin: 大切なお話をしてくれてありがとう
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing such important things with me.

dialogue.origin: もう相談大丈夫っす
dialogue.content: I'm good now; I don't need any more counseling.

dialogue.origin: それでは本日の相談これで終了するね
dialogue.content: Alright then, we'll end today's session here.

dialogue.origin: また、困ったことがあったらいつでも相談に来てね待っています
dialogue.content: If anything else comes up that you're struggling with, please feel free to come talk anytime. I'll be here for you.

dialogue.origin: （有難うございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: （時間オーバーすみませんでした。。）
dialogue.content: (Sorry for going over time.)

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした！
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time!

dialogue.origin: （迫真の演技でした！有難うございます）
dialogue.content: (That was very convincing acting! Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （それでは失礼いたします）
dialogue.content: (Well then, I'll be going.)

topic.sub: お婆ちゃんとの同居生活に関する問題
